ἐπιέλπεο: ἐπιέλπομαι — hope, expect; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted -εο (= Attic ἐπιέλπου): μὴ … ἐπιέλπεο ’do not expect’
ἐπιγνάμψασα: ἐπιγνάμπτω — bend, curb, bend to; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having curbed’
ἐπιεικὲς: ἐπιεικής — fitting, suitable, proper; neut. nom. sg., used impersonally with ἐστί
ἐπιπείθεο: ἐπιπείθομαι — obey (+ dat.); pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic ἐπιπείθου)

ἐριδαίνετον: ἐριδαίνω (ἐρίζω) — quarrel, contend; pres. 2 dual: ’you two quarrel’
ἐσθλῆς: ἐσθλός — good, noble, fine; fem. gen. sg., with δαιτός
ἐτήτυμον: ἐτήτυμος — true, real; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly’
ἐφήσεις: ἐφίημι — send upon, set on; fut. 2 sg., + acc. + inf.: ’you will make (me) …’
ἐφείω: ἐφίημι — send upon, lay on; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic ἐφείω (= Attic ἐφῶ); χεῖρας ἐφιέναι ’lay hands on’
ἐχθοδοπῆσαι: ἐχθοδοπέω — be at odds with, quarrel with (+ dat.); aor. inf. act.
ἑδέων: ἕδος — seat, chair; neut. gen. pl., uncontracted (= ἑδῶν)
ἑκάστῳ: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. dat. sg.
ἑὸν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δῶμα: ’his own’
ἔμπης: ἔμπης — nevertheless, in any case, for all that; adv.
ἔνθά: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’)
ἔπειθ: ἔπειτα — then, thereafter; adv., elided (ἔπειθ’ = ἔπειτα before a rough breathing)
ἔργ: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ἔργ’ = ἔργα)
ἔσεαι: εἰμί — be; fut. 2 sg., epic ἔσεαι (= Attic ἔσῃ): ’you will be’
ἔσοντ: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 pl., epic ἔσονται, elided (ἔσοντ’): ’will be’
ἔσταν: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 pl., root aorist, intrans., epic (= Attic ἔστησαν): ’stood’
ἔτλη: τλάω — bring oneself to, dare, endure; aor. 3 sg. (ἔτλην, inf. τλῆναι)
ἔχ: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’held, kept’
ἔχετ: ἔχω — have, hold; mid. cling, hold on; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἔχετ’ = ἔχετο): ’kept holding on’
ἕκαστα: ἕκαστος — each, every; neut. acc. pl. used substantivally: ’each thing, everything’
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἕνεκα: ἕνεκα — on account of, for the sake of; prep. + gen.
ἠέλιον: ἥλιος — sun; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted ἠέλιον (= Attic ἥλιον)
ἠγνοίησεν: ἀγνοέω — fail to recognize, not know; aor. 3 sg. act., negated by οὐδέ: ’did not fail to recognize’
ἠελίοιο: ἥλιος — sun; masc. gen. sg., epic ἠελίοιο (= Attic ἡλίου)
ἠελίῳ: ἥλιος — sun; masc. dat. sg., epic ἠέλιος (= Attic ἥλιος)
ἤϊ: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic ἤϊε, elided (ἤϊ’ = ἤϊε; Attic ᾔει): ’went’
ἥρῃ: Ἥρη — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. dat. sg. Ἥρῃ (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα)
ἥφαιστον: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; masc. acc. sg.
ἥφαιστος: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; nom. sg.
ἥψατο: ἅπτω — fasten; mid. touch, take hold of (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. mid.
ἦδος: ἦδος — pleasure, delight; neut. nom. sg.
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἦρχ: ἄρχω — begin, rule; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἦρχ’ = ἦρχε), + inf.: ’was first to (speak)’
ἧχι: ἧχι — where; epic relative adv. (= Attic οὗ)
ἰδοῦσ: ὁράω — see; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἰδοῦσ’ = ἰδοῦσα; aor. stem ἰδ-): ’having seen’
ἰδυίῃσι: οἶδα — know; perf. part. fem. dat. pl., epic ἰδυίῃσι (= Attic εἰδυίαις): ’skilful’
ἰόνθ: εἶμι — go, come; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., ἰόντα elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (ἰόνθ’): ’coming’
ἱκάνοι: ἱκάνω — come, reach, come upon (= ἱκνέομαι); pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’might come upon’
ἵλαος: ἵλαος — gracious, propitious; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἵλεως)
ὀΐεαι: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 2 sg., epic uncontracted ὀΐεαι (= Attic οἴει): ’you suppose’
ὀλέσῃς: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin; aor. subj. 2 sg. (ὀλέσσω, Attic ὀλέσω): ’you destroy’
ὀλίγος: ὀλίγος — little, small, puny; masc. nom. sg.
ὀλύμπου: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, the mountain home of the gods; masc. gen. sg.
ὀλύμπῳ: Ὄλυμπος (epic Οὔλυμπος) — Olympus, mountain home of the gods; masc. dat. sg.
ὀνειδείοις: ὀνείδειος — abusive, reproachful; neut. dat. pl., with ἐπέεσσιν
ὀπὶ: ὄψ — voice; fem. dat. sg. (ὀπὶ καλῇ ’with a beautiful voice’)
ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
ὀφρύσι: ὀφρύς — eyebrow, brow; fem. dat. pl., epic -υσι (= Attic -ύσι)
ὀχθήσας: ὀχθέω — be vexed, be troubled; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’vexed, troubled’
ὄχθησαν: ὀχθέω — be vexed, be troubled; aor. 3 pl.: ’were vexed’
ὅσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; masc. nom. pl.
ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι), neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever’
ὑπόσχεο: ὑπίσχομαι — promise, undertake; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid., ὑπόσχεο (= Attic ὑπόσχου): ’promise!’
ῥῖψε: ῥίπτω — throw, hurl; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔρριψε)

__broaden__.δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
__broaden__.δαιτὸς: δαίς — feast, meal; fem. gen. sg., after ἐδεύετο: ’lacked the feast’ · also fem. gen. sg. depending on ἦδος: ’pleasure of the feast’
__broaden__.εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question · εἰ δή ’if indeed, since’ · also εἰ δ’ ἄγε ’come now’, a hortatory idiom
__broaden__.κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’)
__broaden__.παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; + dat./acc./gen. · also adv., ’beside (him)’ (παρὰ δὲ … Ἥρη ’and beside him Hera’)
__broaden__.σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
__broaden__.τοῦτο: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. acc. sg., object of ἐρέουσα · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’this’ (τοῦτο … τέκμωρ ’this is the sign’)
__broaden__.ἄν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency; with the subj. = future contingency, ’perhaps, may’ · also with the opt., potential: ’would, could’ (οὐκ ἄν τι φέροις ’you could not carry off anything’) · also ὅτ’ ἄν + subj., ’whenever’ (= ὅταν)
__broaden__.ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’)
__broaden__.ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form) in address: ’Hera!’
__broaden__.ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον): ’I saw’ · also aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶδον): ’they saw’
